summary.zh: 生成带动效与视差的品牌落地页
summary.en: Build a premium animated single-file landing page.

description.zh: 根据产品简介生成一份自包含的 HTML 落地页，包含 3D 视觉、滚动动效与视差效果。先用简短问答确定定位，再核对配色和页面结构。页面中的网络字体与动画库需要联网加载。
description.en: Creates a self-contained HTML landing page with 3D visuals, scroll motion and parallax. A short intake locks the positioning before the page is written and checked. Web fonts and the animation library load from the network.
